## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the blue cup onto the disc-shaped light gray coaster

Task description: Move the open blue cup on the left side of the table to the light-gray round coaster near the front center, then release the gripper.

Success criteria: The blue cup rests in the coaster's support area, close to its center horizontally, with the base near the surface; both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Consider a cup-wall section facing the table front with open space, with one finger inside and one outside and pads contacting below the rim. This reduces slipping caused by gripping only the thin edge.
- Match the gripper opening to the cup wall thickness with enough room to insert. Before closing, confirm that the inner finger has passed over the rim and both fingers are actually on opposite sides of the wall, avoiding pressing the rim or knocking over the cup.
- Keep the cup opening facing upward during transport, and lift its base off the table before moving sideways. Leave clearance from the tall beverage cup behind it and orange stand to reduce sweeping contact.
- Lower slowly from above the coaster and release only after confirming that the cup bottom is supported. If gripping the inner and outer walls, withdraw the inner finger upward after releasing to avoid tipping the cup sideways.
